summary.text: Review and update your household information whenever your household changes.

steps.name: Review for changes
steps.text: Review your household information whenever there are changes to your household, such as a move or a new household member.

steps.name: Submit the changes
steps.text: Submit the changes through the MediShield Life e-Service, or call 1800-222-3399.

example_phrasings: When should I review and update my household information?
When do I need to update my household details?
When should I check my household information?

sources.page_title: When should I review and update my household information?

quotes.text: You should review and update your household information whenever there are changes to your household (e.g. when you/your household member(s) move house and updated the NRIC address, or when there are new additions to your household).
You should review and update your household information whenever there are changes to your household
Please submit the changes via the MediShield Life e-Service (https://medishieldlife.moh.gov.sg) and click “Login to access the MediShield Life e-Service”. Alternatively, you can call 1800-222-3399.
